findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_series, get_changes, get_calendar · Private data: verify_answer_receipt, register_alert · Public sink: verify_answer_receipt, register_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_series, get_changes, get_calendar · Private data: verify_answer_receipt, register_alert · Public sink: verify_answer_receipt, register_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
